name: crud-update
description: Apple Calendar client updates an existing event via conditional PUT

steps.note: Conditional PUT with If-Match carrying the current ETag updates the event

request.body:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:update-0001@example.test
DTSTAMP:20260115T000000Z
DTSTART:20260116T090000Z
DTEND:20260116T100000Z
SUMMARY:Updated event
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

steps.note: A stale If-Match must fail with 412 without mutating the event

request.body:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:update-0001@example.test
DTSTAMP:20260115T000000Z
DTSTART:20260117T090000Z
DTEND:20260117T100000Z
SUMMARY:Stale write
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
